correctness.rationale: The primary full text confirms the exact sofic shift, potential, beta(f)=0 and witness z^(n)=a^n b a^infinity used to contradict an exact continuous subaction. Keeping positive slack epsilon and telescoping through time n yields the lower bound after dividing by the exact distance alpha^n. With N=ceil(1/epsilon), g=f-epsilon has S_N g<=0, so u_N=max_{0<=k<N}S_k g satisfies g+u_N∘sigma<=u_N; phi=-u_N is admissible. Cylinder constancy bounds its Lipschitz seminorm by the stated exponential expression. Choosing n=floor(1/epsilon)-2 and N=ceil(1/epsilon) gives the limit.
